system.description:
Built on Project FU's Ace of Cards.

FREE BENEFITS
  • Increased maximum HP or MP (choose one).

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise.)

CARTOMANCER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000054]{Magic Cards} 【Max SL 3】

The deck engine: grants the deck, the hand and the discard pile. In a conflict, action + up to (10 + SL × 5) MP (minimum 10): discard and resolve one card per 5 MP spent, maximum five — the set — then draw that many back.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000055]{Double or Nothing} 【Max SL 1】

Declared before a Check: until it ends, dice showing even numbers count doubled and other dice count 1..

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000056]{High or Low} 【Max SL 5】

When you resolve a set: with a joker and/or 7, +(SL) damage until your next turn; with a joker and/or 1, damage you suffer is reduced by (SL) before Affinities; with none of those, recover (SL × 2) HP immediately. A joker satisfying two rows is the player's choice.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000057]{Mulligan} 【Max SL 2】

When you hit one or more enemies with an attack on your turn, discard up to (SL + 1) cards and draw that many.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000058]{Trap Card} 【Max SL 2】

After an enemy resolves an Attack, Objective, Skill or Spell action, discard up to (SL + 1) cards that are jokers or match the action's suit (Attack ice, Objective fire, Skill earth, Spell air), draw back, then perform the Spell action for free, casting a spell of (SL × 5) MP or less — you still pay the MP. Once per round.
